name: waf-high-block-volume
title: AWS WAF is blocking an unusually high volume of requests
description: AWS WAF has blocked more than 25,000 requests within a 5-minute period. This may indicate malicious activity, bot traffic, a denial-of-service attempt, or an unexpected increase in requests being blocked by WAF rules.
investigation_steps: Open the CloudWatch alarm and identify the affected environment.
Review WAF logs to determine the source IPs, countries, request patterns and terminating rules responsible for the blocked traffic.
Check whether the blocked traffic is concentrated on a single source, distributed across many clients, or associated with a known bot or vulnerability scan.
Confirm that application availability, load balancer health and backend services are operating normally.
If legitimate traffic appears to be affected or service degradation is observed, escalate immediately and consider whether WAF rules require adjustment.
